0022600005.text: The Los Angeles Lakers host the Golden State Warriors in a matchup where both teams open their 2026-27 seasons. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026. The Lakers have five players listed as day-to-day: Adou Thiero, Bronny James, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton and Jarred Vanderbilt. The Warriors are missing Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, while Brandin Podziemski, Charles Bassey and Stephen Curry are also listed as day-to-day, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Lakers a 65% chance to win.
